title: Apple Patches iMessage and Bluetooth Flaws
excerpt: Apple has released updates to address multiple iMessage privacy vulnerabilities and a Bluetooth pairing flaw.
body_html:
Apple has released software updates to address several newly disclosed vulnerabilities affecting iMessage and Bluetooth pairing.

According to the company, one of the patched iMessage issues could have allowed a remote attacker to improperly join an existing group chat and access its messages. A separate group chat flaw could have permitted an individual who was added to a group to view messages that were sent prior to their arrival.

The newly issued updates also address Bluetooth pairing vulnerabilities.

The security fixes apply to several devices, including the iPhone XS, XS Max, and XR, as well as the seventh-generation iPad and other specific Apple models.
